prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
For a family of four, I’d prioritize a **two-bedroom, two-bath rental in Midtown or Edgehill**: you’ll get separate sleeping space and a quieter base than right on Broadway, while staying a short drive from downtown. If you want to walk to the main attractions, look at **SoBro** (south of Broadway), but expect more noise and a busier atmosphere.

A promising option from the listings I found is **“The Nashville Rhythm”** in Midtown: a two-bedroom, two-bath condo with two king bedrooms and a twin-bunk nook. It appears to offer more flexible sleeping arrangements than a typical one-bedroom-plus-sofa-bed rental. [View Airbnb’s Midtown family-friendly listings](https://www.airbnb.com/midtown-nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly).

If you’d rather be downtown, Airbnb’s listings include **two-bedroom, two-bath apartments** with kitchens and amenities such as pools; one listing describes a balcony and included parking. [Browse downtown family-friendly listings](https://www.airbnb.com/downtown-nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly).

Before booking, check the exact dates and total price, recent reviews, parking fees, bed setup, noise comments, and whether the listing is properly permitted. Availability and rates change, so I can’t identify a single best bookable property without your dates and budget.
